USB2.acceptance: fabricator field-solved width/gap and post-layout pair report

WAND_POWER.notes: Keep charger IN/SYS/BAT capacitor loops and TPS63900 VIN/LX/VOUT loops at the pins; no sensitive IMU return through switching loops.

RECEIVER_LOAD_1A.notes: 5-12 V SELV only; calculate with actual stackup and temperature-rise target; load return does not cross RF/USB/MCU return path.

ISOLATED_SIGNAL.notes: Low-voltage signal isolation intent only. Maintain manufacturer package creepage/clearance; no plane, test pad, mounting metal or shield bridges the moat. Not a mains insulation rating.

placement_rules.rule: Place NINA-B302 at the board edge with its integrated PIFA facing a nonconductive enclosure region. Reproduce the current u-blox module courtyard/host-ground restriction exactly; no copper, vias, battery, cable, metal fastener, shield can or tall component in the controlled antenna zone.
placement_rules.status: exact keepout must be imported from UBX-NINA-B3-SIM-R15 during native layout

placement_rules.rule: Do not route SWD, USB, switching nodes or load current beneath/across the antenna zone. Preserve a continuous ground reference at the module ground region outside that keepout.
Place each data-sheet capacitor at its named power pin before routing; exposed thermal pads use the exact manufacturer land pattern and thermal-via review.
Place LSM6DSV16X on mechanically stiff PCB away from haptic actuator, board edge, USB connector and inductor. Mark package axes on silkscreen and assembly drawing.
Keep DRV2605L differential actuator loop compact and separated from IMU and antenna. Route OUT+ and OUT- as a pair and never reference either output to ground.
Place receiver MOSFET, flyback option and load terminal together. Keep the high-di/dt load loop out of logic ground paths and provide copper temperature measurement access.
Place optocoupler across the isolation moat; floating collector/emitter terminal stays entirely on the field side.
